episodes.title: Going Under
episodes.summary: A notorious biker gang is infiltrated in the opener of this series examining the underground counterculture of motorcycle clubs.

episodes.title: A Tough Prospect
episodes.summary: Falco earns his road name; and he saves a botched drug deal.

episodes.title: Patched In
episodes.summary: Falco loses an ally and his girlfriend's trust.

episodes.title: Dangerous Game
episodes.summary: Stash kills a drug dealer, and a determined DA's attempt to convict him threatens Falco's cover.

episodes.title: Solitary
episodes.summary: Falco moves up the ranks of the Aryan brotherhood while serving a monthlong sentence.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.summary: Falco's mission nears an end, and Agent Koz wants him to lay low, but when Schizo demands he pull off a major drug deal, keeping a low profile proves difficult.

episodes.title: Nowhere Man
episodes.summary: Falco receives an unexpected job offer while struggling to put the past behind him in the witness-protection program.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.summary: Falco agrees to go back undercover and is assigned to work with an uptight and single-minded ATF agent, and the two are soon summoned to meet The Devil.

episodes.title: Mongol Nation
episodes.summary: Falco and Bullet head to California, where Falco hopes to earn his patch, but his past may come back to haunt him.

episodes.title: Black Rain
episodes.summary: Operation Black Rain comes to a premature conclusion, and Falco's role as an undercover agent puts him in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Club Adios
episodes.summary: Falco is requested to partner with his old nemesis Darko, which leaves him to contemplate quitting the mission; and the Devil and posse arrive to inspect the new clubhouse, and the night takes a hellacious turn.

episodes.title: Inlaws and Outlaws
episodes.summary: A chance run-in with the Devil exposes Falco and girlfriend Sarah Jane, putting them in a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: End of the Road
episodes.summary: Falco's chapter is ordered to off a rival biker, but Meredith gets wind of the plan and threatens to end the operation. Meanwhile, Bullet has other ideas, and a scheme unfolds to fool the Devil.

episodes.title: The Devils Patch
episodes.summary: A missing cell phone that contains candid video recordings threatens to derail Falco's operation and leaves him facing a pivotal moment of truth.
